about: Bookmarks of the cities module. Walk-mode views stand at (lat, lon) facing the target (a monument or the city centre) at local midday on the given historical year (negative = BC); 'orbit' views look down on the target from altitudeKm. Coordinates WGS84 (modern; cities are within the last 10 000 years).
